But opposing Garchomp could EQ back; we're at 51%, sash used. Scaleshot is best—super effective, likely KO or heavy damage.

decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Opponent Garchomp used Protect last turn, likely to scout or stall. Garchomp is faster (+1 speed from Scale Shot, 163-253 range vs our 149). Make It Rain: Steel vs Dragon/Ground is neutral (Steel vs Ground neutral, vs Dragon neutral... actually Steel vs Dragon is neutral, vs Ground neutral). 120 BP Life Orb from 185 SpA vs Garchomp's lower SpD — likely big damage, maybe KO? Garchomp took Earthquake from our Garchomp down to 4%... wait that was opposing Kingambit. Opposing Garchomp is full HP. Make It Rain from 185 SpA Life Orb vs Garchomp SpD ~94-150: likely 2HKO or close to KO. Garchomp is faster and will hit us with Scale Shot (super effective, 2 hits could kill? Scale Shot boosted, we're full HP 162). Scale Shot vs Gholdengo: Dragon vs Steel/Ghost — Dragon is neutral vs Steel, neutral vs Ghost. Physical 25 BP x2 hits, Garchomp Atk up to 200, +0. Not huge. But Garchomp could also have Earthquake (super effective on Steel). We don't know its other moves. Risk: Earthquake KOs us.

Make It Rain likely doesn't KO full Garchomp (roughly 60-80%?). Actually 120 BP Life Orb 185 SpA vs Garchomp min SpD 94: could be near KO. Garchomp HP 183-215. Let's estimate: Gholdengo SpA 185, Make It Rain 120 BP, Life Orb 1.3. Neutral damage vs Garchomp (SpD say 120): damage ≈ ((2*50/5+2)*120*1.85/120... formula: ((22+2)*120*185/120)/50+2 = (24*120*1.54)/50+2 = 4435/50+2 ≈ 90.7, *1.3 = 118, *0.925 random ≈ 106-118. Garchomp HP 183-215. So ~50-64%. Not a KO. Garchomp then hits us — Scale Shot neutral won't kill, but Earthquake would (Ground vs Steel/Ghost super effective? Ground vs Steel SE, vs Ghost neutral → 2x). Earthquake from 200 Atk: ~((22+2)*100*200/120)/50+2 = (24*1.667*200)/50+2 ≈ 160+2=162, *1.5 = 243 — KOs us.

Hmm, but did it reveal Earthquake? No. It used Scale Shot and Protect. Garchomp likely has EQ. So staying in risks being EQ'd. But if we switch Kingambit in, Garchomp EQ is immune (Ground vs Flying? Kingambit is Dark/Steel, EQ hits neutral... actually EQ vs Steel neutral, Dark neutral). Kingambit resists Scale Shot? Dragon vs Steel resisted, Dark neutral → 0.5x. Kingambit is a good switch-in vs Garchomp. But then Gholdengo loses momentum.

Alternative: Make It Rain now, chip Garchomp to ~50%, then it KOs us with EQ, we send Kingambit. Or switch Kingambit now, Garchomp likely EQ (immune? no—EQ hits Kingambit neutrally, decent damage from 200 Atk vs Def 140: ~((24)*100*200/140)/50+2 ≈ 68+2=70, neutral ~70, Kingambit 175 HP, fine). Then Kingambit can Sucker Punch/Kowtow.

Actually wait — Garchomp at +1 speed outspeeds Kingambit anyway. Kingambit Sucker Punch priority works if Garchomp attacks. Kowtow Cleave vs Garchomp: Dark vs Dragon neutral — 85 BP from 205 Atk: ~((24)*85*205/120)/50+2 ≈ 87+2=89... not KO.

Better: Make It Rain puts Garchomp in Kingambit Sucker Punch range? After ~55% damage, Garchomp at ~45%. Sucker Punch 70 BP from 205 Atk: ~((24)*70*205/120)/50+2 ≈ 72+2=74, could KO 45% Garchomp (~90 HP of 183-215). Close. Also Garchomp might Protect again or attack.

But risk: Garchomp EQs us this turn and we die, wasting Gholdengo. However Gholdengo's Make It Rain chip is valuable, and if Garchomp doesn't have EQ... Scale Shot only revealed. Many Garchomp run EQ/SR/Scale Shot. It used Protect turn 3 — maybe scouting Make It Rain damage? It protected while we attacked.

Actually the deciding factor: Garchomp outspeeds and likely KOs Gholdengo with EQ. But if we switch, we keep Gholdengo healthy. Kingambit is a solid pivot: resists Scale Shot, takes EQ neutrally, threatens with Sucker Punch. I'll switch Kingambit.

Hmm, but Make It Rain chip then Kingambit revenge could be better long-term? If Garchomp EQs, Gholdengo dies (162 HP, EQ ~240 dmg). Losing Gholdengo (our best wincon with Nasty Plot) to get ~55% on Garchomp is bad. Switch is safer.

Decision: SWITCH: kingambit.
